turns.content: When allyl acetoacetate is heated, which named rearrangement and subsequent step account for its conversion into an unsaturated ketone?
Trace the carbon skeleton through that thermal rearrangement and decarboxylation, then draw and name the major product.
For that product, identify the saturated proton environments in its 1H NMR spectrum. Keep carbon-site counting separate from proton-level chemical equivalence.
Extend the same measurement and counting convention to the unsaturated region, identifying every distinct environment there.
Combine the environments identified so far to obtain the total number of distinct signals for the current measurement.
Check the result by listing each chemically distinct environment individually rather than relying only on a site count.
Report the signal count for the major product and the relevant equivalence conclusion.
